comments.comment: Thank you Shylah & sending all the love and support back to you that you so freely give ♥️
Thank you for Sharing. I experienced something Similiar and it‘s always good to know that I am Not Alone 🙏🏽🧡
Inspiring hearing your story sister. Ty for sharing.. so essential that we talk about this 🕯️🌹
Thank you for sharing this, sending so much love and my deepest compassion 🫂💕💕💕
I adored this share as you know I work as a doula 🔥 I my self had aborted twins which broke my heart because I wanted them. None the less I looked at my two girls and knew what I had capacity for.
Hugs mama ❤️ sending soft and gentle loving energy to you and your mama bear 🐻 heart and womb 🔥 you’re amazing and thank you for sharing your truth. It takes courage 🦁🧡🙏🏽🦋🦅
wow. this is so powerful. thank you for sharing such a vulnerable piece of you 😭🥹
Thank you for sharing this story! I didn’t even realize an herbal abortion would be possible.

Ooof. Feeeeel this. Such a deep topic we definitely need more open conversation around. This is very new moon Scorpio seed planting for womb bearers to remove the stigmas and find healing around the intensity of these thresholds.
Thank you so much for your raw vulnerability about this. I experienced an abortion for similar reasons as yours and it will be six years ago in two days on the 22nd.
Thank you for sharing something so heavy and honest. Your strength and compassion for yourself through such a hard moment really shows. Sending you so much love as you continue healing ❤️‍🩹
Thank you for sharing. ✨

You are so beautiful and this is so true ,the pain women endure , and the misagony we have to live with , we are so beautiful and so close to creation ,i think that is why the patriarchy wants to shame , smear and belittle us

I was pregnant at 16 and my mom took me. I didnt have a say. It created a scar in my heart. But I was able to go on. At 21 , naive, I was pregnant again and this time let my partner convince me to terminate. I took the pills and I was never the same. My hormones, my mind. My spirit. I read a book where Whoopi Goldberg shared her stories and it helped me so much. Inhad my first son at 25. I feel healed after having my sons but I spent years not being okay after the one when I was 21.
Thank you for talking about this. It needs to be spoken of more so women (and men) Can support eachother through this and share resources/knowledge
🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼 Women are so strong 💪🏽 This is real - thanks for keeping it that way
Thank you for sharing your experience so openly. It’s not a topic women should hide or feel shame, but we do.

Hi. I love you. Thank you for being vulnerable in a world of people who judge you based on their own self righteousness. And thank you for shining a light on this truly humane process that requires more emotional stamina than surgical abortion. You are a warrior. I honor you with love. And I will pray the women on this thread deal with their shadows- because that is the only place they speak from. ❤️
Your baby will always be a part of you regardless, you will still have their cells in you and will continue too for the rest of your life. Thankyou for sharing, it’s not an easy journey. ❤️
Thank you so much for sharing this. Your words are so meaningful and this type of experience is never talked about. ❤️🙏🏼
Thank you for sharing. It’s not easy

This really does need more voices. Thank you for sharing and being vulnerable. I personally had to terminate for medical reasons and some would very much frown upon that but you have to do what’s best for you and your family. Be proud of making the best decision for you. ❤️
Yess to herbal abortions
I've had 4 miscarriages ( 3 D&Cs) and 3 biochemical pregnancies. Still no children. I know the pain. 💔😔🙏

One day I hope you are able to call it what it is. You murdered your baby. You poisoned your child when it was at its most vulnerable. You said you talked to your child. Well, I’m positive of you would have asked him, he would have begged to live.
